assessment.summary: This is a review article titled 'The search for novel insecticide targets in the post-genomics era, with a specific focus on G-protein coupled receptors'. It does not contain original empirical data on insecticide resistance markers in African Anopheles populations.
exclusion_reasons: Not a primary empirical study (it is a review article).
Does not report original genotype data for insecticide-resistance markers.
Does not report on African field populations.
